metadata.description: Hermes: full-stack production agent team for Claude Code. 9 specialized agents + trend-scout covering all 14 layers of production development.

plugins.name: hermes-core
plugins.description: Orchestration core: product-architect (Opus), scratchpad handoff protocol, docs command

plugins.name: hermes-design
plugins.description: design-director: UI/UX direction, design systems, motion. Pair with frontend-design@claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: hermes-frontend
plugins.description: frontend-engineer: TS/React/Next.js implementation with visual self-verification

plugins.name: hermes-data
plugins.description: database-engineer: PostgreSQL, migrations, RLS, query optimization

plugins.name: hermes-platform
plugins.description: platform-engineer: hosting, cloud, IaC + CI/CD via gh CLI (no GitHub MCP)

plugins.name: hermes-quality
plugins.description: qa-engineer (TDD, Playwright E2E) + security-auditor (Opus, Trail of Bits methodology)

plugins.name: hermes-sre
plugins.description: sre-engineer: error tracking (Sentry), observability, performance, caching, availability

plugins.name: hermes-scout
plugins.description: trend-scout: daily ecosystem scanner (report-only) + solution-evaluator: /evaluate a specific repo/plugin/skill/MCP — studies it + real developer feedback, verdicts adopt/replace/trial/skip, drafts integration

plugins.name: hermes-verify
plugins.description: Verification layer: code-reviewer (0-100 + evidence) + runtime-verifier (boots front+back+db, e2e) + verification-protocol (independent gate re-run + retry loop) + Ultracite lint standard + per-layer policy packs. Makes 'done' = working code

plugins.name: hermes-ecc
plugins.description: Vetted adoptions from ECC (MIT): silent-failure-hunter, react-reviewer, typescript-reviewer + context-budget & codebase-onboarding skills. See plugins/hermes-ecc/ATTRIBUTION.md
